sources.citation: Hofer, Theresia. 2017. Is Lhasa Tibetan Sign Language emerging, endangered, or both? International Journal of the Sociology of Language 245: 113-145. doi:10.1515/ijsl-2017-0005 (Europe PMC author manuscript PMC5638009)
sources.note: Nothing; sociolinguistic overview of TibSL emergence/endangerment. Zero hits for stress/prosody/phonology/handshape/syllable/non-manual. States that documentation is limited 'by the absence of an adequate grammar' and that improving documentation 'will require.. the creation of a TibSL grammar'.

sources.citation: Hofer, Theresia. 2022. Time and timelines in Tibetan Sign Language (TSL) interactions in Lhasa. In Matsuoka, Crasborn & Coppola (eds.), East Asian Sign Linguistics, 311-345. Berlin: De Gruyter Mouton.
